integration_validation.arbitrary_coordinate_job: not part of the WS2 checks (coordinate jobs are WS4's)
integration_validation.golden_fields: errante build for the five official targets: 40 real DR1/QR3 exposures each (200 frames), 29 false-color season composites; errante validate reports 5 valid fields
checks_reported_in_pull_requests: #16: reprojection matched an astropy per-pixel reference to 6e-8 on 12 real Barnard's Star cutouts; Barnard's Star lands 0.10-0.20 px (median) from its proper-motion position
#31: forced photometry of a normal field star near Epsilon Indi agrees with 2MASS J/H/Ks to 2-6 %

integration_validation.checks_basis: Run with AI assistance and reported in the pull request bodies; not independently verified by a human

cache_revision: No WS2 change to the processing cache; WS4's processing fingerprint (backend/errante_api/processing.py) hashes the WS2 imaging and detect modules, so WS2 code changes invalidate cached products
model_basis: Co-Authored-By trailers of the WS2 commits name Claude Opus 5.5; review subagents ran inside Claude Code and their individual models were not recorded

other_ai_tools.scope: Per-frame archive flag fractions on the common grid (reproject.summarize_flags, FrameFlagSummary, frame_flags in the five published field.json), computed from the real SPHEREx FITS cutouts with no change to the rendered images; V0id47 with Claude Code reviewed the computation and recomputed all 200 summaries independently

other_ai_tools_basis: Apart from #119 (OpenAI Codex, by mateoa007), the commits of the WS2 pull requests carry only Claude co-author trailers; no other AI model, provider or coding tool, and no PRC-origin one, was used for this work
ai_review: Several pull request bodies record review passes run by AI agents in Claude Code (per-target checks in #17, the ECC plugin python-reviewer agent in #31, adversarial reviewers and verifiers in #16, #19, #41 and #48); these are AI reviews, not human reviews
idea_origin: Not covered by this record: the product vision is recorded in docs/VISION.md and AI_USAGE.md; this record covers implementation work only

rendered_products.origin: The PNG frames and false-color composites are renders of measured NASA SPHEREx DR1/QR3 pixel values (IMAGE - ZODI, from IRSA), produced by running the AI-assisted WS2 code, not AI-generated imagery; saturated star cores that SPHEREx left empty and detector-defect pixels are filled from their neighbours for display only (in the composites, a pixel bad in every frame of a channel is drawn neutral, display only), as each field.json's provenance.notes state
rendered_products.labels: Each field.json states its processing in provenance.notes (IMAGE - ZODI in MJy/sr, asinh stretch, display-only repairs); composites are labelled false color (infrared), not true color, in the notes and the UI
rendered_products.nasa_branding: No NASA logo, flag or mission identifier was generated, added or modified
